tasks.name: Sound Map
tasks.objective: Produce the Sound Map for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every audible event mapped to a sound with priority
Spatialisation, attenuation and concurrency rules stated
Licence or authorship recorded for every external sound

tasks.name: Sound Set and Mix
tasks.objective: Produce the Sound Set and Mix for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every mapped event has at least one sound with variation
Loudness normalised to the project target and clipping-free
Compression and streaming format chosen per sound class

tasks.name: Mix Review
tasks.objective: Produce the Mix Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Combat, dialogue and ambience audible in a full scene without masking
Voice-count and memory measured against budget
